reading: A festival landing page: no-box nav with brand left and links right, a big centred 'Pick your night' heading with a hollow 'night', lavender subtext, a real CSS 3D rotating cube carousel of night/stage cards flanked by prev/next pill buttons, a 4-dot pagination indicator, and an off-white 'Get Friday pass' CTA pill — all set over a gradient page with a tilted perspective grid 'floor' behind everything.
